review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer Lead
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Summary The Systems Engineer Lead leads day-to-day systems and cloud engineering operations for the Mosaic Infrastructure Managed Services engagement, overseeing a team responsible for server, cloud, storage, middleware, IAM, and database platforms across the client's roughly 60-site footprint in the United States, Canada, Brazil, Peru, and Paraguay. Responsibilities Lead the day-to-day work of the systems and cloud engineering team, assigning and prioritizing tickets, changes, and projects
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role combines senior hands-on engineering with team leadership, ensuring the data center and cloud environment is reliable, secure, and scaled appropriately, while working closely with the Cloud/Infrastructure Architect on design and standards. Provide hands-on senior-level engineering support for complex server, virtualization, storage, and cloud issues that require escalation beyond Tier 2/3. Skills And Experience What You’ll Bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in Systems Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or a related field, including 2+ years in a Lead or supervisory role. Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies, such as VMware or Hyper-V, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
